title: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA set to headline Coachella 2027
summary_full: The California festival has unveiled its lineup, which also features Madonna, Phoebe Bridgers and RobynThe lineup for the 2027 Coachella festival has been revealed after months of speculation, with Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala set to headline the California event.The festival will also see Madonna headlining the dance tent with Zara Larsson, Robyn, Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer and Daddy Yankee set to perform. The festival will take place in the Empire Polo Club in Indio on 9-11 April and 16-18 April. Continue reading...
